full_judgment: 33. On perusal of the judgment of the Court of Appeal, it appears that the appellate Court upon misreading and non-consideration of material evidence and misconception of law reversed the findings and decision of the trial Court. The impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal. Accordingly, interference is called for by this Court.
